review_notes: I read the whole target file. I searched Mathlib for other star-convexity notions and found Mathlib/Geometry/Convex/Star.lean, which defines `Convexity.IsStarConvexSet`. I also looked at how it is used in Geometry/Convex/ConvexSpace/Module.lean. I did not check other parts of the file for competing concepts. Both files carry a TODO about replacing `StarConvex`, so the duplication is known and the migration is staged on purpose. I did not find a bridge lemma between the two predicates. The ConvexSpace version also needs `IsStrictOrderedRing`, which `StarConvex` does not, so an equivalence would only hold under the stronger assumptions. This finding is therefore moderate-confidence and about integration, not a claim of a mistake.

findings.problem: Mathlib now has two independent predicates for the same concept, star-convexity of a set at a point. `StarConvex` is the module-based one. `Convexity.IsStarConvexSet` is the ConvexSpace-based one. The second is stated for a general `ConvexSpace R X` and uses `convexCombPair a b ha hb hab x y` in place of `a • x + b • y`. The two lists of lemmas overlap heavily: empty, univ, singleton, inter, union, sInter, iInter, iInter₂, sUnion, iUnion, iUnion₂, mem, prod, pi, image and preimage under affine maps, add, neg and sub. Neither file has a lemma relating the two predicates. Results proved for one cannot be reused for the other, and users have to pick one API. Both files record a TODO to replace `StarConvex`, but that is an intent and not an integration.
findings.proposed_change: Add a bridge lemma for the module `ConvexSpace` instance, under `IsStrictOrderedRing`: `StarConvex 𝕜 x s ↔ Convexity.IsStarConvexSet 𝕜 x s`. This should follow from the convexCombPair-equals-smul-add lemma for modules. Then either deprecate the duplicated `StarConvex` lemmas (inter, union, prod, pi, image and preimage under affine maps, and the others) in favour of the generic ones, or define `StarConvex` as an abbreviation of `IsStarConvexSet`. Keep the existing names for the module API (`StarConvex.add_smul_mem`, `StarConvex.smul_mem` and similar). Because `StarConvex` needs fewer assumptions (a `Semiring` with a `PartialOrder`, and no strict ordering), the unification would need generalising the ConvexSpace side or keeping a restricted version.
findings.benefit: There would be one star-convexity API instead of two parallel developments. Lemmas would no longer need to be proved twice. Users could move between module-style and ConvexSpace-style statements without redoing proofs.
